Both2 Kings 19:35andIsaiah 37:36report that in a single night, 185,000 Assyrian soldiers were killed by an angel of the Lord. The Joseph Smith Translation ofIsaiah 37:36clarifies that some survivors awoke in the morning to find the dead corpses (seeOld Testament Revision 2, 107,josephsmithpapers.org). It has been suggested that the number of 185,000 Assyrian casualties could have been exaggerated to emphasize the Lord’s power in the miraculous deliverance of Judah (see Michael D. Coogan and others, eds.,The New Oxford Annotated Bible: New Revised Standard Version, 5th ed. (2018), 571, note on2 Kings 19:35).
